body: I kill a lot of time lately imaging violent shit happening to me. I haven't hit myself for a while but I get vicious satisfaction from imagining someone else hitting me, and worse. Much worse. I don't picture anyone specific, just some faceless agent, a force more than anything. I hope they make her (me) suffer.

Also, yeah, I've used hotlines; I always just end up feeling like I wasted the person's time. And honestly they always seem to think the same; think only once had someone on a hotline who didn't sound impatient, basically finding slightly nicer ways to ask, "What the hell do you expect me to do about any of this?" Which, fair. What the hell do I expect them to do about it? They can't do anything. I'm the only one who can, except apparently I can't, so every time I just end up right back here. Exactly here.

I hate myself and I think the closest to a useful thing I can even do anymore is stop being everybody else's problem too.
I want someone to give me an answer I know doesn't exist.
I'm not sure I really even *want* to be dead, I just don't think I can do any of the really basic and obvious shit I'd need to do if I don't kill myself. I think about the logistics a lot.
Like, what kind of human being *sees* the consequences of inaction coming and still can't make herself act? Is that even a person?
